title: One way out
author: Steffen Görzig (story), Oliver Lindau (cover)
description:
On the left side, a man with his heart full of tears.

On the right side, a woman with her head full of fears.

On both sides, desperate beings seek to break out of spheres.

(This game is intended to be experienced in the Inform 7 development environment, reading the source code and playing the compiled story at the same time.)
